Cameo Reference Map

Every Cameo actor with the reference unit chosen from each source, by full id and name, split into units that exist in the original games and units that do not. The bar on each chip is match confidence. HP →, speed → and cost → are the R4 synthesis targets — references plus Cameo, one vote each. Nothing here has been written to yaml.

73 originals · 78 expanded · 285 references · 21 priced by formula · 4 originals under three sources

td_gdi · 14 original, 18 expanded

Originals · 14

These exist in OpenRA/OpenTD, so a counterpart exists in every source and all three must be present and must be the same unit. Anything short of three, or any reference that is not plainly the same unit, is a defect worth reporting.

Weapon calculation details

Raw source values are not directly comparable across games. The model normalizes each source before projection; the rate below is a source-local damage/tick estimate, not a sustained gameplay DPS claim. Unknown delays remain unavailable. Reviewed nominal cycles exclude armor, splash totals, travel and upgrades. The separate travel sample uses fixed endpoints without scatter, blockers or speed modifiers. Tick calls start at the first projectile update, not the firing order; seconds depend on game speed. Unmodeled guided/custom projectiles remain unavailable, and conditional slots are not summed.

Per-armament references — one weapon, one vote

Here each armament finds its own reference weapon and gets its own target, and a source that does not carry a weapon in that role does not vote on it. This also covers a one-gun Cameo actor whose reference actor has several guns; the actor-level fold may otherwise select the wrong peer weapon. = exact role match · ~ a dual-role weapon stood in. An unproven role abstains rather than voting. Air is never paired with ground. A c on a range marks a value converted from TS cells (1 cell = 1024 WDist). The reference column is projected through the same coordinates and the same frozen ruler as every other target on this page.

An unproven role abstains rather than voting. Air is never paired with ground. A c on a range marks a value converted from TS cells (1 cell = 1024 WDist). td_gdi_predatortank
Weapon calculation details

Raw source values are not directly comparable across games. The model normalizes each source before projection; the rate below is a source-local damage/tick estimate, not a sustained gameplay DPS claim. Unknown delays remain unavailable. Reviewed nominal cycles exclude armor, splash totals, travel and upgrades. The separate travel sample uses fixed endpoints without scatter, blockers or speed modifiers. Tick calls start at the first projectile update, not the firing order; seconds depend on game speed. Unmodeled guided/custom projectiles remain unavailable, and conditional slots are not summed.

Per-armament references — one weapon, one vote

Here each armament finds its own reference weapon and gets its own target, and a source that does not carry a weapon in that role does not vote on it. This also covers a one-gun Cameo actor whose reference actor has several guns; the actor-level fold may otherwise select the wrong peer weapon. = exact role match · ~ a dual-role weapon stood in. An unproven role abstains rather than voting. Air is never paired with ground. A c on a range marks a value converted from TS cells (1 cell = 1024 WDist). The reference column is projected through the same coordinates and the same frozen ruler as every other target on this page.

Weapon calculation details

Raw source values are not directly comparable across games. The model normalizes each source before projection; the rate below is a source-local damage/tick estimate, not a sustained gameplay DPS claim. Unknown delays remain unavailable. Reviewed nominal cycles exclude armor, splash totals, travel and upgrades. The separate travel sample uses fixed endpoints without scatter, blockers or speed modifiers. Tick calls start at the first projectile update, not the firing order; seconds depend on game speed. Unmodeled guided/custom projectiles remain unavailable, and conditional slots are not summed.

ra1_soviets_mammothtank
Weapon calculation details

Raw source values are not directly comparable across games. The model normalizes each source before projection; the rate below is a source-local damage/tick estimate, not a sustained gameplay DPS claim. Unknown delays remain unavailable. Reviewed nominal cycles exclude armor, splash totals, travel and upgrades. The separate travel sample uses fixed endpoints without scatter, blockers or speed modifiers. Tick calls start at the first projectile update, not the firing order; seconds depend on game speed. Unmodeled guided/custom projectiles remain unavailable, and conditional slots are not summed.

Per-armament references — one weapon, one vote

Here each armament finds its own reference weapon and gets its own target, and a source that does not carry a weapon in that role does not vote on it. This also covers a one-gun Cameo actor whose reference actor has several guns; the actor-level fold may otherwise select the wrong peer weapon. = exact role match · ~ a dual-role weapon stood in. An unproven role abstains rather than voting. Air is never paired with ground. A c on a range marks a value converted from TS cells (1 cell = 1024 WDist). The reference column is projected through the same coordinates and the same frozen ruler as every other target on this page.

Stationary unupgraded base burst, full-damage centerline and near-range region, one pulse hit per actor. Armament snapshots damage modifiers before the immediate Attacking notification increments burstcount: ten shots at125%, then fifteen at82%. Decimal percentage multiplication truncates each final shot damage toward zero. The60-tick revoke-all timeout exceeds intra-burst2 but is shorter than reload80, so the counter resets before the next uninterrupted burst. Mean damage is shown only as shorthand; exact per-shot damage is retained. Target changes, interruptions, upgrades, target armor, travel and off-axis falloff excluded; nominal source model, not battle proof.

Per-armament references — one weapon, one vote

Here each armament finds its own reference weapon and gets its own target, and a source that does not carry a weapon in that role does not vote on it. This also covers a one-gun Cameo actor whose reference actor has several guns; the actor-level fold may otherwise select the wrong peer weapon. = exact role match · ~ a dual-role weapon stood in. An unproven role abstains rather than voting. Air is never paired with ground. A c on a range marks a value converted from TS cells (1 cell = 1024 WDist). The reference column is projected through the same coordinates and the same frozen ruler as every other target on this page.

Per-armament references — one weapon, one vote

Here each armament finds its own reference weapon and gets its own target, and a source that does not carry a weapon in that role does not vote on it. This also covers a one-gun Cameo actor whose reference actor has several guns; the actor-level fold may otherwise select the wrong peer weapon. = exact role match · ~ a dual-role weapon stood in. An unproven role abstains rather than voting. Air is never paired with ground. A c on a range marks a value converted from TS cells (1 cell = 1024 WDist). The reference column is projected through the same coordinates and the same frozen ruler as every other target on this page.
